hero.alt: Bottles of champagne presented in the family cellar

presentation.title: Come visit our vineyard and cellar!
text: Our vineyard is 4 hectares. It is situated in the surroundings of the "Grand Cru" villages of Avize and Oger. In this area, Chardonnay is the only grape variety growing. In our vineyards, which are around 50 years old, we maintain a sustainable agriculture by the association of both tradition and respect for the environment.

In our cellar, we make the wine through an artisanal production (no filtration, riddling by hand). Furthermore, we do a particularly long "élevage sur latte" which means that after the second fermentation, the bottles lay down in our cellar for many years. During this process, the dead yeasts that remain in the bottles are going to decay and bring a unique taste to the wine. This means new aromas, better champagne foam and a full bodied wine.
Here, we introduce to you a very unique vintage wine "blanc de blancs" recognizable by its toasted aromas and brioche flavours.

contact.title: Feel free to contact us
contact.text: Our activity is mostly focused on the wine making and less on the commercial work that comes with it. Therefor, we recommand you to send us an e-mail or to call us before your visit so that we can make ourselves available.

brut.title: Brut
brut.text: This cuvée is a blend of different grands crus of the "Côte des Blancs" and different years. The malolactic fermentation is made. The "dosage" is 6 g/L. This wine has citrus aromas, typical of Champagne blanc de blancs.

millesime.title: Millésime
millesime.text: This cuvée is 100 % chardonnay and comes from blocks of vineyards which are more than 50 years old. The wine is not filtered and undergoes aging during many years in our cellar. Aromas are complex and different each year. The acidity is more present and the low dosage brings verticality and a good length on the palate.

rose.title: Rosé
rose.text: This cuvée is a blend of 40% pinot noir, 40% pinot meunier and 20% chardonnay. The aging process in the cellar lasts from 2 to 3 years. Its aromas are depicted as close to raspberry and strawberry. As you taste it, those aromas are filled with a great acidity. The dosage is  at 6 g/L.
